name: Rev D (design): every lift point settled by statics - south: A-frame strap pairs from the head to two feet 600 mm either side (feet in the middle of truss bays, 450 mm U-cradles bearing under the floor edge truss, screwed over the middle 150 mm); north (marriage side): one vertical hanger strap on the inside face into a 450 mm U-cradle, head on the inside face; saddle heads with no fasteners (sideways restraint only; north heads also keyed along the module); floor and roof bridging; at most 4 screws per web joint; folded cleats at every truss end; no temporary parts; pinned-beam cascade set to the measured CoG; design cases R4, 8 tilt cases at 2 deg and 4 sideways cases; skew and rigid-frame cases reported for robustness

v_strap.label: A-frame strap pair: 50 x 1.2 G450, one on each wall face, 2 x M12 8.8 each end
v_strap.label_inner: A-frame strap: one 50 x 2.4 G450 strap on the inside face, 2 x M12 8.8 each end

guide.label: lifting head saddle: folded 3 mm G450 box over the roof edge truss with running clearance (no fasteners), M20 lifting pin with a 40 mm free-turning sleeve
guide.label_inner: lifting head on the inside face: folded 3 mm G450 bracket bearing on the inside face of the roof edge truss (no fasteners), M20 pin with sleeve

floor_diaphragm.label: floor plane cross-bracing, 30 x 1.0 G300 steel strap (tension-only pair modelled as half area both ways)

roof_diaphragm.label: roof plane cross-bracing, 30 x 1.0 G300 steel strap (tension-only pair modelled as half area both ways)

cradle.label: cradle: two 3 mm G450 cheek plates (120 long, 140 high) each side of the floor edge truss bottom chord, joined under the chord by 2 x M16 8.8 bearing bolts with 95 mm sleeves, one under each truss joint of the pair, each with a 3 x 40 x 89 bearing packer; cheeks screwed to the chord flanges at the first joint only (2 per cheek), bearing only at the second

foot_plate.label: foot plate on the inside face: 3 mm G450, 600 x 300, screwed to both chords at 7 stations (3 screws per chord per station)

hanger.label: hanger strap pair: 50 x 1.5 G450, one on each face of the edge truss, 2 x M12 8.8 each end
hanger.label_inner: hanger strap: one 50 x 3.0 G450 strap on the inside face, 2 x M12 8.8 each end

gussets.note: n = 10 stands for the 4 joint screws plus a 1.5 mm G450 gusset plate on each face (3 screws into the web member, 3 into the chord, per face); inside a cradle footprint the cradle cheek is the gusset
